name: Proceeds Definition
definition: Definition of exchanges of cash and/or securities available in the processing of corporate actions.

SpecialConcessionAmount.name: Special Concession Amount
SpecialConcessionAmount.definition: Amount of drawdown or other reduction from or in addition to the deal price.

CreditDebitIndicator.name: Credit Debit Indicator
CreditDebitIndicator.definition: Specifies whether the value is a debit or credit.

EarliestPaymentDate.name: Earliest Payment Date
EarliestPaymentDate.definition: Date on which a payment can be made, eg, if payment date is a non-business day or to indicate the first payment date of an offer.

ValueDate.name: Value Date
ValueDate.definition: Date/time at which assets become available to the account owner (in a credit entry), or cease to be available to the account owner (in a debit entry).

NonEligibleProceedsIndicator.name: Non Eligible Proceeds Indicator
NonEligibleProceedsIndicator.definition: Specifies information regarding outturn resources that cannot be processed by the CSD. Special delivery instruction is required from the account owner for the CA outcome to be credited.

IssuerOfferorTaxabilityIndicator.name: Issuer Offeror Taxability Indicator
IssuerOfferorTaxabilityIndicator.definition: Proceeds are taxable according to the information provided by the issuer / offeror.

OfferPriceFixingDate.name: Offer Price Fixing Date
OfferPriceFixingDate.definition: Date/time at which an offer price is determined (as compared to its reset date if applicable).

CountryOfIncomeSource.name: Country Of Income Source
CountryOfIncomeSource.definition: Indicates the country from which the income originates.

Option.name: Option
Option.definition: Option for which proceeds are specified.

CorporateAction.name: Corporate Action
CorporateAction.definition: Corporate action for which the proceeds are specified.
